definitions.gloss: thorough knowledge; deep familiarity; mastery of a subject
definitions.explanation: Possessing comprehensive, detailed knowledge of a particular field or subject. Implies expertise gained through deep study or long experience.

examples.japanese: {法律|ほうりつ}に{通暁|つうぎょう}している。
examples.english: To have thorough knowledge of the law.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{日本|にほん}の{歴史|れきし}に{通暁|つうぎょう}した{学者|がくしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is a scholar with thorough knowledge of Japanese history.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{情勢|じょうせい}に{通暁|つうぎょう}した{人材|じんざい}が{求|もと}められている。
examples.english: There is a demand for talent with deep knowledge of international affairs.

examples.japanese: この{分野|ぶんや}に{通暁|つうぎょう}している{人|ひと}は{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: Few people have mastered this field.

notes:
A literary, formal word meaning to have deep, comprehensive knowledge of a subject. Almost always used with the particle に in the pattern 〜に{通暁|つうぎょう}する/している. More elevated in register than {詳|くわ}しい or {精通|せいつう}する.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{通暁|つうぎょう}する: to have thorough knowledge of
- 〜に{通暁|つうぎょう}している: to be deeply familiar with
- 〜に{通暁|つうぎょう}した{人|ひと}: a person with mastery of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精通|せいつう}する: to be well-versed in — similar meaning, slightly more common
- {詳|くわ}しい: knowledgeable about, detailed — everyday word for being well-informed
- {博識|はくしき}: erudition, wide learning — emphasizes breadth rather than depth
- {熟知|じゅくち}する: to know thoroughly — similar formality, emphasizes familiarity through experience

FORMS:
{通|つう} (to pass through, to be versed in) + {暁|ぎょう} (dawn, to understand thoroughly) — suggests knowledge that penetrates completely, like dawn illuminating everything.
